First Half: Tapia Breaks the Deadlock On August 23, 2026 , the match kicked off with high energy, though Platense faced an early hurdle when Fernando Tobio was forced off due to injury, replaced by Nicolas Capraro in the 17th minute. The early stages were physically demanding, with Mateo Mendia picking up a caution shortly before the game’s first major turning point. In the 23rd minute, Barracas Central earned a penalty, and Ivan Tapia made no mistake from the spot, coolly converting to give the home side the lead. As the first half progressed, the referee was kept busy as the match grew increasingly feisty. Yellow cards were shown to Norberto Briasco , Nicolas Demartini , and Kevin Jappert as both teams battled for control in the midfield. Despite the rising tension and several interruptions, Barracas Central managed to hold onto their slender advantage heading into the halftime break. Second Half: Platense’s Stunning Response Returning for the second period, Platense introduced Gonzalo Maroni to spark their offense. The tactical shift paid dividends in the 59th minute when Franco Zapiola orchestrated a move that allowed Nicolas Retamar to fire home the equalizer. The momentum swung back and forth as both managers utilized their benches, with Luciano Gimenez entering the field for Platense in the 69th minute to provide a fresh attacking threat. Just as the match looked destined for a draw, drama unfolded in the 90th minute. Bautista Merlini provided a perfectly timed assist for Luciano Gimenez , who clinicaly found the back of the net to complete the comeback. Despite five minutes of stoppage time, Barracas Central could not find an answer, and the referee’s final whistle confirmed a spectacular away victory for Platense .
